references.text: Dogs have surrounded me; a band of evil men has encircled me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
I offered my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who pulled out my beard. I did not hide my face from mockery and spitting.
They clothed me in a red robe, wove a crown of thorns and placed it on my head.
The soldiers led Jesus into the courtyard, that is, the praetorium, and called together the whole guard.
Herod and his soldiers mocked and ridiculed him. After dressing him in an elegant robe, they sent him back to Pilate.
The soldiers wove a crown of thorns and placed it on his head, and clothed him in a purple robe.
